steps.npc: Nilsal, [player name]. How are things going?

steps.player: Pretty good, thanks. How about you? Made any more discoveries down here?

steps.npc: More than you can count! I've found so much new information on the Old Ones and naguanil. The museum are hoping to include it all in some new exhibits soon!

steps.player: Sounds awesome! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for them. On that note, I'll let you get back to it.
